_note: Frozen interop vectors for the cozygateway push-v0 envelope. app_vector is the vector CozyKit/Tests/CozyKitTests/PushCryptoTests.swift pins for the app's own PushCrypto; plugin_sealed was produced by cozychat/push.py seal() and is opened by the Swift side in HermesPluginReleaseTests, so both directions are proven against real app bytes. key_material_hex is hex of the UTF-8 bytes of the push-key string the phone keeps in its Keychain, which is exactly what `plugin device add` writes to keys/<device_id>.
